content_html:
Rahuanqui It is a small hidden paradise in the Andean region of Cusco, Peru, just 45 minutes from the city. Nestled among gentle hills, green fields and endless skies, this place offers one of the most magical sunrises in southern Peru, far from noise and mass tourism.

Where is Rahuanqui?

Rahuanqui is located in the province of Anta, on the way to Sacred Valley, about 30 km from the city of Cusco. It is easily accessed by private car or through organized tours. It is a rural, safe and quiet area, with spectacular views of the Peruvian Andes and an ideal environment to reconnect with nature.

What can you do in Rahuanqui?

Here, the experience goes far beyond observing a landscape:

  • See the sunrise between clouds and mountains: The sky turns pink, gold and orange as the sun rises between the Andean peaks.
  • Enjoy an Andean picnic outdoors: Artisan bread, fresh fruits, natural infusions... all on a blanket in the middle of nature.
  • Connect with Pachamama: Walking barefoot on the earth, breathing fresh air, looking at the sky without rushing.
  • Landscape photography: Ideal for photographers, content creators or lovers of natural beauty.
  • Authentic cultural encounters: Sometimes you can share with local communities, learn from their traditions and understand their respect for the land.

What does a sunrise in Rahuanqui awaken in you?

In Rahuanqui, not only do you see the sun rise... feel how something is born inside you.

When you are there, surrounded by the silence of the mountains and the whisper of the Andean wind, everything seems to fit:

  • Your mind calms down, your thoughts soften, and the noise of the world fades away for a while.
  • You take a deep breath —perhaps for the first time in a long time— and you feel how the pure air cleanses you inside.
  • The heart is filled with a simple and powerful peace, as if the earth itself embraced you.
  • You discover the beauty of the simple: a hot mate, a blanket, a view that cannot be explained... just living.

Rahuanqui, in Cusco, Peru, welcomes you with simplicity and truth.
It offers you the essentials: a real pause, a connection with yourself and with everything around you.
It is a place where the soul breathes, and where every sunrise reminds you that you are alive.

Live Cusco at its best

Enjoy the best of Cusco this June with GT Peru Travel and experience an unforgettable sunrise in Rahuanqui.
Anticipate and secure your place in this unique, natural and transformative experience!
Sometimes you just need to see the sun rise to come back to you.
